evidence.observation: Pressure 3.045 Torr at start of growth, in line with ramp baseline ~3.04
Pressure rose steadily to 3.338 Torr (+0.3 Torr over 600 s) with no setpoint change
Ar flow steady ~100 sccm, so more gas in is not the cause of the rise
T holding at 750 °C, heater power stable ~46%, so the thermal side is normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so air getting in cannot be checked

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading or a leak-up test (isolate the pump and watch the pressure-rise rate) would show whether this is a seal leak or an exhaust/pump-line blockage. Post-run characterization of the sample is also needed.
